items.summary: Delhi airport is working with security regulators to ease clearance procedures for transfer passengers, who account for 30-35% of its annual traffic, GMR Airports Executive Director S G K Kishore said. He also defended airport charges, saying higher infrastructure investments push up tariffs, which could decline over time.

items.title: Bata puts its best foot forward on profits as inventory shrinks, distribution expands
items.summary: Bata India is banking on distribution expansion and tighter inventory management to drive growth, as adjusted profit before tax surged 31.4% year-on-year in Q2 FY27, outpacing revenue growth of 7.5%. The footwear maker has expanded its key retail outlet network 2.6 times and targets 5,000-plus outlets by Q3 FY27.

items.summary: The software giant's stock fell after earnings failed to impress investors.

items.title: What do passengers get onboard Vande Bharat Sleeper train? Viral video takes viewers inside Delhi-Varanasi journey, shows meal & bedding
items.summary: An Instagram reel showing the facilities inside the Vande Bharat Sleeper train has crossed 2 million views. Shared by @vlogwithprateek_, the video offers a glimpse of the onboard meals, bedding arrangements and sleeper coach interiors during a Varanasi-New Delhi journey. The new service connects the two cities via Prayagraj, Kanpur Central, Aligarh and Ghaziabad.

items.summary: Apple hit record quarterly revenue in India by pushing device prices above $1,000, but iPhone sales volumes dropped up to 25% as steep price hikes deterred first-time buyers.

items.summary: The former White House communications director also said the Republican party was facing a "civil war" after the result.

items.title: NPPA updates list of reduced MRP of 1,085 anti-cancer drugs
items.summary: The National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority updated the maximum retail price for 1,085 anti-cancer medicines. This revision follows a previous decrease of prices for 543 anti-cancer drugs announced on October 28. The updated list contains prices based on information submitted by pharmaceutical companies up to November 3. The NPPA will continuously update this list as more manufacturers submit revised prices.

items.title: AdaniConneX in talks with global banks for $1.5 billion loan: What will the funds finance?
items.summary: AdaniConneX is reportedly seeking about $1.5 billion in offshore financing for data centres, as Adani and Reliance ramp up investment in AI and digital infrastructure. The expansion reflects India’s growing demand for computing capacity.

items.title: NTT DATA to nearly triple Mangaluru workforce to 2,500 by 2027; expansion to focus on AI, cloud
items.summary: The proposed expansion is expected to strengthen Mangaluru's position as an emerging technology destination under Karnataka's broader strategy to attract investments and create employment opportunities beyond Bengaluru.

items.title: CleanMax beats Q2 EBITDA estimates, reports strong H1 growth
items.summary: CleanMax has surpassed analyst estimates for the third consecutive quarter, driven by portfolio expansion and strong business performance. The company reported a 58% rise in H1 EBITDA and a six-fold increase in profit after tax (PAT), highlighting its robust growth momentum and improving financial performance.

items.title: Bagmane REIT declares Rs 527cr distribution to unitholders for September quarter
items.summary: Bagmane Prime Office REIT announced a distribution of Rs 527 crore to unitholders for the September quarter. The company leased 1.2 million square feet during this period, achieving a committed occupancy rate of 99 percent. Most of the leasing activity was directed towards Global Capability Centres in Bengaluru, which highlights their preference for quality assets. The average rent achieved was slightly above the prevailing market rates, reflecting strong demand.

items.title: Binance says North Korean hackers stole $6.34 billion funds in a technical breach
items.summary: Binance reported a cyberattack attributed to North Korea that compromised $6.34 billion in digital assets. Approximately $2.85 billion of the affected assets have since been frozen or intercepted. The attackers utilized fake job interviews and advanced malware to breach Binance's security systems. Subsequently, the company took steps to replenish the lost assets and mitigate the damage caused.

items.title: Sebi levies Rs 40 lakh penalty on four entities in Axis MF front-running case
items.summary: Securities and Exchange Board of India has imposed a total penalty of Rs 40 lakh on four entities. This penalty includes fines on Woodstock Broking and Marfatia Stock Broking for front-running trades. The investigation spanned from April 1, 2021, to March 31, 2022, involving these entities. Evidence indicated that brokers facilitated these trades by providing necessary infrastructure and assistance.

items.title: BLS International Q2 results: Record revenue on Digital Services growth, but can strong earnings revive shares?
items.summary: BLS International reported record Q2 FY27 revenue of ₹973 crore, up 32% year-on-year, with growth in Visa and Consular Services and Digital Services. H1 revenue rose 28.7% to ₹1,863 crore. Quarterly EBITDA increased 16.6% and profit after tax grew 8.6%.

items.title: Utkarsh Small Finance Bank reports sixth consecutive quarterly loss
items.summary: Utkarsh Small Finance Bank experienced a loss of Rs 70 crore in the second quarter, marking six consecutive quarters of decline. The lender’s operating profit was Rs 85 crore, but provisions of Rs 166 crore led to the net loss. Its gross non-performing asset ratio improved slightly, standing at 5.96% at the end of September. The bank's gross loan portfolio saw a year-on-year growth of 7.5%, reaching Rs 20,062 crore.

items.title: PNB staffer, Pune man arrested in alleged Rs 10.24 crore bank fraud case
items.summary: An office assistant of Punjab National Bank in Greater Noida and a private individual have been arrested for alleged fraud. The fraudulent activity involved Rs 10.24 crore in unauthorized withdrawals from multiple customer accounts. Punjab National Bank's investigation began after a customer reported suspicious debit transactions in her account. The accused allegedly carried out the transactions over three years using compromised banking credentials.

items.summary: Titled Vision 2047: Solar Manufacturing from Polysilicon to Power Plant, the report presents a pathway for India to move beyond module assembly and set up manufacturing capabilities across the entire solar value chain -- from polysilicon and ingots to wafers, cells and modules, the statement said.

items.title: Johnnie Walker launches first India-inspired Blue Label festive blend in its 200-year history
items.summary: The Johnnie Walker Blue Label Festive Blend, crafted by the brand's Master Blender Dr Emma Walker, draws on the country's rich culinary heritage and flavour traditions, the company said in a statement.

items.summary: Air India has suspended flights to several destinations in Europe and the United States, including Vienna, Copenhagen, Chicago, Newark, London Gatwick and Birmingham. The airline has also shifted some domestic routes to Air India Express.

items.summary: Nexus Select Trust reported an 8% year-on-year increase in net operating income for the second quarter. The company's retail assets experienced a 13% rise in consumption compared to the previous year. Nexus declared a distribution of Rs 359 crore, maintaining a 100% payout to unitholders for 13 consecutive quarters. The firm is expanding its portfolio with plans to develop a Grade-A mall and hotel in Guwahati.

items.title: Loan growth, fall in provisions help SBI profits in Q2
items.summary: State Bank of India reported a 14% year-on-year rise in Q2 FY27 net profit to Rs 23,038 crore, driven by 18% loan growth, higher net interest income, lower deposit costs and reduced loan loss provisions.

items.summary: Indian equities rallied nearly 2%, with Sensex gaining 1,225 points and Nifty rising 370 points. Falling crude prices, renewed FII buying, resilient earnings and expectations of LTCG tax changes boosted sentiment, adding nearly Rs 4 lakh crore to market capitalisation.

KKR-backed Sapphire US Holdco will also subscribe to securities of Gentari Renewables India, which specializes in renewable energy.

items.summary: Reserve Bank of India has announced the November 2026 round of the Inflation Expectations Survey of Households. This survey aims to capture households' perceptions regarding price movements and inflation based on their consumption patterns. Additionally, the Urban Consumer Confidence Survey seeks to understand household sentiments on the economic situation and employment. The Rural Consumer Confidence Survey collects perceptions from rural areas on economic conditions, income, and spending.

items.title: Gulf Oil eyes market leadership in India, global expansion to drive next growth phase
items.summary: Gulf Oil aims to surpass its rival and achieve the market leader status in India's lubricants sector. The company plans to invest approximately ₹55 crore to expand its manufacturing capacity significantly. Growth is expected from B2B, industrial, and infrastructure segments, alongside exploring new niches like data centre cooling.

items.summary: IndiGo CEO Willie Walsh said IndiGo had established the necessary foundations to succeed in the long-haul market. The planned introduction of Airbus A350 aircraft forms part of the airline's broader international expansion strategy.

India head Jurgen Westermeier called the country a "very important market" and stressed the need to strengthen local manufacturing, MRO infrastructure and aviation training as the country's aircraft fleet expands.

Apple falls after a disappointing outlook, while Palantir declines and Fiserv rallies following its earnings beat.

items.title: Road ministry signs MoU with Bihar to use river silt for national highways construction
items.summary: The ministry of road transport and highways signed an MoU with the Bihar government for river desilting. This initiative aims to use excavated silt in ongoing and future National Highway construction projects. A total of 1,078 lakh cubic metres of silt is planned for utilization in 43 highway projects in Bihar.

The company experienced strong demand in healthcare, aerospace, and industrial water markets during the third quarter. DuPont's healthcare and water technologies segment reported nearly 4% growth year-over-year, reaching $865 million in net sales. Additionally, the company recently concluded a $250 million share repurchase program and plans to buy back an additional $250 million of shares.

items.title: SBI targets 14-15 pc credit growth, govt may revisit LTCG tax amid FPI outflows: Chairman CS Setty

items.summary: The airline plans to expand its Asian network through Delhi and explore Bengaluru as a third hub as mounting losses sharpen its focus on costs.

items.summary: Ferrari has revised its earnings outlook for 2026 due to impressive third-quarter performance that exceeded expectations. The company noted a 12% increase in adjusted EBITDA, greatly surpassing analyst forecasts. This growth stems from sales of high-margin vehicles and personalized customer requests. However, the total vehicle shipments dipped slightly, totaling 3,368 in the July-September timeframe. The robust order book extends through 2028, with more product launches on the horizon.

items.summary: The association has sought a time-bound restoration plan and clarity on unpaid coupons, while questioning the bank's role in selling the bonds to individual investors.

items.summary: In the race towards the US midterm elections, over $1.48 billion has been wagered through prediction markets such as Kalshi and Polymarket, highlighting their role in shaping political discourse. Experts raise alarms about the potential fallout if market outcomes deviate from real election results, which could undermine credibility. Notably, key Senate contests are intensifying market activity, indicating favorable odds for Democratic gains in Congress.

items.title: FLY91 plans to expand fleet to 60 aircraft in five years, targets 350 weekly flights: CEO Manoj Chacko
items.summary: Regional airline FLY91 plans to expand its fleet from six to around 60 aircraft over five years, backed by an order for 40 planes scheduled for delivery between 2027 and 2032. The airline also aims to operate nearly 350 weekly flights this winter, prioritising domestic expansion before exploring international routes.

items.title: Why does IndiGo want lower charges at Mumbai airport? CEO Willie Walsh weighs in on airport investments
items.summary: IndiGo CEO Willie Walsh says Mumbai airport’s per-passenger charges should fall after Terminal 1’s redevelopment increases capacity. He argues airport costs affect fares and airlines’ ability to earn returns, and calls for closer scrutiny of airport investments and their impact across the industry.

items.title: Bata India Q2 Results: Profit rises 30% at Rs 18 crore, revenue rises to Rs 862 crore
items.summary: Bata India Ltd achieved a 30.4% increase in net profit for the September quarter of FY27. Revenue from operations also rose by 7.54% to Rs 861.78 crore compared to the previous year. The company noted significant growth in profit after tax, driven by higher average selling prices. Bata India aims to maintain this growth momentum despite rising input costs and wage revisions. Shares of Bata India Ltd increased by 1.

items.title: CCI approves Kotak Mahindra Bank's acquisition of Deutsche Bank's India retail banking business
items.summary: Kotak Mahindra Bank Limited has received approval from the Competition Commission of India for its acquisition. This acquisition involves Deutsche Bank AG's retail, private banking, and wealth management businesses in India. The deal includes significant assets like loans and deposits, benefiting around 150,000 customers. Additionally, a referral arrangement will be established between both banks through their affiliates.

items.title: NSE Q2 results: Profit rises 23%, EBITDA doubles in first post-IPO earnings; how has stock fared since listing?
items.summary: NSE reported a 23% year-on-year rise in Q2 FY27 consolidated net profit to ₹2,578 crore, supported by stronger trading volumes. Revenue from transaction charges grew 9% to ₹3,035 crore, while operating EBITDA more than doubled to ₹3,079 crore.

items.title: 15+ features of India's first Bullet Train: Not just 280 kmph speed, check its interiors, passenger facilities and advanced technology
items.summary: India's first indigenous bullet train, B28, is designed to run at an operational speed of 249 kmph and a testing speed of 280 kmph. With eight coaches and a passenger capacity of around 557, it will feature Wi-Fi-based infotainment, multilingual information screens, ergonomic seating and modern safety systems. Trial runs on the Mumbai-Ahmedabad corridor are targeted for May-June 2027.

items.title: Russia confirms new Ukraine peace talks as Melania Trump prepares to host ceasefire meeting
items.summary: Russia confirmed Ukraine peace talks in Abu Dhabi next week and signaled a possible Trump-Putin-Xi summit, raising questions over Kyiv's role in negotiations.

items.title: Tata-Iveco combine eyes significant growth in volumes, revenues over next 5 years: Chandrasekaran
items.summary: Tata Motors and Iveco Group expect significant growth in vehicle volumes, revenues and margins over the next five years following their combination, Tata Sons Chairman N Chandrasekaran said. The combined entity will have annual revenues of around $24 billion, operations in over 130 countries and a portfolio spanning trucks, buses and specialised vehicles.

items.title: India bonds end tad higher on softer oil
items.summary: Indian government bonds experienced a modest rise as the 10-year bond yield neared a one-month peak. Investor optimism was bolstered by decreasing oil prices, although caution was still prevalent ahead of the upcoming US midterm elections. The benchmark bond yield displayed its lowest point since early October after notable drops in earlier trading sessions.

This rise is attributed to the government's recent duty hike on gold and silver imports. The increase in informal shipments is linked to previous tax increases that incentivized smuggling and cash sales. Gold demand typically rises during major festivals, though year-on-year metrics indicate a decline.
